summary_1line: Vyasa explains that the understanding creates perceived objects while the Soul remains a detached witness; through knowledge and sense-control one realizes the Self and attains freedom.

image_candidates.scene_text: A yogin sits motionless in meditation while a small lamp dispels darkness, revealing a radiant inner soul.
An aquatic bird glides across water without getting wet, symbolizing the sage untouched by the three qualities.
A person tightly holds the reins of restless horses representing the senses, bringing them under the command of the mind.
